name.ja: HGBC 1/144 ジムジムウエポンズ

description.ja: • 様々な組み合わせができるカスタマイズ性抜群のウエポンパーツがHGBCに登場！
description.en: • Highly customizable weapon parts that can be combined in various ways are now available at HGBC!

description.ja: • 12個のパーツは多種多様な組み合わせが可能で、特に連邦系のガンプラとの相性は抜群！
description.en: • The 12 parts can be combined in a wide variety of ways, and are especially compatible with the Federation Gunpla!

description.ja: • 基本の4形態のほかにも色々な組み合わせが可能で、様々なガンプラと組み合わせて楽しむことができる！
description.en: • In addition to the four basic forms, various combinations are possible, and you can enjoy combining it with various Gunpla!

accessories.ja: フォアエンドパーツ（3種）×各1
